phases.name: reproduce
phases.intent: Reproduce the defect deterministically; no investigation proceeds on a guess.

phases.name: locate
phases.intent: Trace the exact failing call-chain in read code, file:symbol.

phases.name: root-cause
phases.intent: Why-chain to the violated invariant, not the surface symptom.

phases.name: generalize
phases.intent: Abstract the root cause to its defect CLASS and the single invariant that kills the whole class.

phases.name: sweep
phases.intent: Sweep the WHOLE codebase for every instance of the class — found and checked-clean. Deferring a sibling is illegal.

phases.name: fix-spec
phases.intent: Plan a fix for EVERY swept instance, each RED-first, plus a class-guard test.

phases.name: verify
phases.intent: Confirm RED→GREEN per instance, the class-guard passes, and the original reproduction passes.

description: A defect is investigated to a CLASS-COMPLETE fix, never an instance patch. Reproduce → locate → root-cause → GENERALIZE to the defect class → SWEEP the whole codebase for every instance → fix-spec covering all of them (each RED-first, plus a class-guard test) → verify. The generalize+sweep phases are load-bearing: no defect closes until its class is swept, so 'the same class of bug we already fixed' becomes structurally impossible. A human governor seals the completed investigation.
